1.en_consolidated_definition: Heroine (noun): A female given name derived from the Greek word for "hero" or "demigod". In Puerto Rican culture, it is also associated with the female figure of a heroine in literature and folklore, particularly in the works of local authors such as Julia de Burgos and Lola Rodríguez de Tió.
